notes.title: My Friend Toby Update 2.1.0
notes.notes:
What's new:
[list]
[*] You can now escape the bonus map by completing a list of challenges.
[*] Added a Eye icon that informs the player on how fast Toby is and when he'll be enraged. 
[*] Added more stuff to do on the main map after escaping.
[*] Added a new achievement.
[/list]
Changes:
[list]
[*] To prevent confusion, the boss fight pentagram doesn't have numbers on it anymore.
[*] Moved one of the camera flash targets in the bonus map.
[*] When booting the game for the first time, the game will no longer display at the lowest possible resolution.
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the bonus map being able to trigger the same challenge twice in a row.
[*] Fixed one of the achievements unlocking, even though you haven't completed it.
[*] Fixed the controller menu displaying the incorrect button layout.
[*] Fixed a Typo in Lyle's dialogue when interacting with the TV
[/list]

notes.title: My Friend Toby Update 2.0.2
notes.notes:
Fixed a couple bugs and Improved gameplay.
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the player was able to crouch while the wake up animation is playing.

notes.title: My Friend Toby 1.1.0 - The Noisy Door Update
notes.notes:
Unfortunately there was a major flaw in the games save system, causing the game to break if new content was added. To fix this the entire save system had to be overhauled, resulting in everyone's progress being wiped. To minimize damage the game will set your high scores based on what Steam achievements you already had unlocked. Apologies for not noticing this issue before launch, this won't happen again.

[b]What's new:[/b]

- Toby can hear you open/close doors now
- Doors can now be opened/closed quietly
- Added a new upgrade
- The old crosshair visual has been replaced with a hand icon that will only be visible if you hover over something that can be interacted with
- The main door textures have been improved
- The doors SFX have been changed
- The noise indicator visual has been changed
- Fixed Toby randomly switching back to it's wander state immediately after entering it's chase state
- Fixed certain Steam achievements not popping up immediately after completion 
- Announced Story Mode

notes.title: My Friend Toby 1.0.18

- Camera Icon on the top left will now be faded until the camera has fully recharged

- Added a note on the map Recollection (Map 1) to explain how Toby behaves
